summary: APM feed c031_nic is degraded: tool NIC eth1 is discarding 1.47% of packets (38,520 discards) due to capture overrun, while physical link is healthy. Visibility is incomplete.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is delivering traffic at a rate/volume exceeding the APM's 10G capture interface capacity. APM eth1 NIC ring buffers overrun and discards 38,520 packets (1.47% loss, threshold 0.1%). Link errors are healthy, so loss is not L1/L2 errors but tool-side oversubscription.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM loses ~1.47% of flows/transactions. Results in gaps in latency/error-rate metrics, incomplete distributed traces, and missed performance anomalies; both-directions correlation required by APM is broken for dropped flows.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute c031_nic traffic across 2+ APM ingress ports/instances with flow-aware hashing to keep per-interface rate below 10G and eliminate discards while preserving both directions per flow. APM needs_full_payload=false so complementary broker slicing/filtering can further reduce load if full payload not required.
